title: A normalized completed Chern adjunct splits off the completed unit
statement: Let ell be prime, f:X→S a morphism of Noetherian schemes equipped with the diagonal trace localizations, t a diagonal trace Result over ULift Q_ell, and assume ell is a unit in the global sections of S. For any b:completedUnit(ell,S)→t.Rc.R(completedLine(ell,X)[2]) satisfying CompletedChernNormalized for t.toPresentation, there exists v:completedLine(ell,S)[2]→t.Rc.R(completedLine(ell,X)[2]) such that biprod.desc v b is an isomorphism. The first component is not prescribed.

source.place: paragraph (1), the positive twist and shift of the completed tower splitting

proof.text: Apply positive twist and shift to the existing isomorphism of the model splitting. The proved component identities and endpoint isomorphisms identify the second component with model.chernAdjoint.

Apply restriction and the recorded derived inverse limit. The unit and source-line comparisons are invertible, as is sourceMap by line_limit. The given normalization of b identifies its underlying map with the transported second component.

Both shifted completed lines are derived complete. Completeness is preserved by shift and by the chosen completed direct image, using the exact ordinary pullback adjunction and the recorded right-derived comparisons. Lift the first component by full faithfulness of scalar restriction on complete objects.
The underlying completed scalar restriction is exact and faithful. Its derived functor therefore reflects isomorphisms, by testing homology. It reflects the lifted biproduct splitting.

proof_origin.place: Normalized completed Chern splitting; complete scalar restriction lifts its first component.
